name: Sharda Cropchem Limited
summary: Sharda Cropchem Limited, a crop protection chemical company, engages in the provision of various formulations and generic active ingredients worldwide. The company operates through Agrochemicals and Non- Agrochemicals segments. It offers agrochemical products, including insecticides, fungicides, herbicides, veterinary drugs, plant growth regulators, fumigants, regulators, rodenticides, dithianon, metalaxyl, propiconazole, phenthoate, pendimethalin, and dithianon; and biocides.
